$comment:
REQ-EXP-002: expeditions have events and decisions, not only fights. Each event is a *choice the Guild AI makes on the player's behalf* against their objective and policy, and every option states its cost — so the route report can explain the decision (v1.0 §14) rather than announcing an outcome.

`weight` is how often the event is drawn. `zoneTiers` and `hazards` gate it to places it makes sense in (REQ-ZON-002: zones differ in events). `risk` is how much the option resembles a gamble; the Guild AI weighs it against the objective's own risk preference.

events.name: An abandoned cache
events.description: Someone else's supplies, left in a hurry. The lid is jammed and prising it open will take time the party does not obviously have.

options.label: Force it open
options.consequence: Salvage, at the cost of a noisy delay.

events.name: A collapsed passage
events.description: The direct way on is buried. There is a longer way round, or the party can dig.

options.label: Dig through
options.consequence: Straight on, but the party arrives tired.

options.label: Go around
options.consequence: Safe, slow, and the long way passes something else.

events.name: A wounded stranger
events.description: Not a guild hunter. They are in a bad way and cannot walk out alone.

options.label: Carry them out
options.consequence: The expedition ends here, and the guild is owed a favour.

options.label: Patch them up and press on
options.consequence: Costs supplies and a little conscience.

events.name: Still water
events.description: The flooded stretch is quiet, which is worse than if it were not.

options.label: Wade straight across
options.consequence: Fast, and whatever is under there notices.

options.label: Edge around the wall
options.consequence: Slow and cold, but nothing wakes up.

events.name: The singing gets louder
events.description: It is coming from further in. Every hunter has now noticed, and pretending otherwise is its own kind of cost.

options.label: Press toward it
options.consequence: Whatever is making it will be found sooner.

options.label: Stop up their ears and work around
options.consequence: Slower, and nobody sleeps well afterwards.

events.name: Defensible ground
events.description: A dry corner with one way in. Worth an hour, if the party has an hour.

options.label: Make camp
options.consequence: The party recovers, and the day gets shorter.

options.label: Push on
options.consequence: Keeps the light, keeps the wounds.
